records.ground_truth_text: CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY COMMISSION RECALL NOTICE Product Name: Infant Sleeper Deluxe Bassinet Manufacturer: BabyCare Global Industries Ltd. Recall Date: 2026-03-15 Hazard: Suffocation and entrapment risk due to loose side railings. Remedy: Immediately stop using the bassinet and contact manufacturer for refund. Recall Number: CPSC-26-089 Units: 45,000

FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION URGENT ALERT Product Name: Metformin Hydrochloride Extended-Release 500mg Manufacturer: Apex Pharma Laboratories Inc. Notice Date: 2026-04-10 Hazard: Detection of NDMA impurity above acceptable daily intake limit. Recommended Action: Return affected lots to pharmacy for replacement. Recall Number: FDA-D-2026-442

SAFETY WARNING: BICYCLE BRAKE CABLE FAILURE Brand: Apex TrailMaster Mountain Bikes Date: 2026-05-02 Hazard: Front brake cable detachment can cause crash and serious injury. Consumer Action: Stop riding immediately and schedule free repair. Campaign ID: BIKE-26-901

NATIONAL HIGHWAY TRAFFIC SAFETY DEFECT NOTICE Product Name: Wireless Tire Pressure Monitoring Sensor Manufacturer: SafeDrive Auto Components Recall Date: 2026-06-18 Hazard: Inaccurate pressure readings may lead to undetected tire blowout. Action: Authorized dealers will inspect and replace sensor module free of charge. Recall ID: NHTSA-26V-112

FDA PUBLIC HEALTH ADVISORY: SALMONELLA CONTAMINATION Product: Organic Crunchy Peanut Butter 16oz Distributed by: NutriHarvest Brands Recall Date: 2026-07-22 Risk: Potential contamination with Salmonella bacteria causing severe illness. Remedy: Do not consume product. Return to store of purchase for full refund. Lot Codes: Lot 2605-B and Lot 2606-A

PRODUCT SAFETY RECALL: CERAMIC SPACE HEATER Product Name: WarmHome 1500W Oscillating Space Heater Manufacturer: WarmHome Electric Appliances Date: 2026-08-30 Hazard: Internal heating element can overheat and ignite casing, posing fire hazard. Recommended Action: Unplug heater immediately and register for replacement kit. Recall Identifier: HEATER-26-440 Units: 120,000

SAFETY RECALL NOTICE: 2-SLICE ELECTRIC TOASTER Product: QuickToast Deluxe Smart Toaster Manufacturer: CulinaryTech Devices Inc. Date: 2026-09-12 Hazard: Heating coils can remain energized after pop-up cycle. Remedy: Disconnect from power outlet and request repair box. Recall ID: CPSC-TOAST-26

BATTERY PACK OVERHEATING RECALL Product Name: Lithium-Ion 20V Max Power Drill Battery Manufacturer: PowerCraft Tool Corporation Recall Date: 2026-09-25 Hazard: Battery cells can short circuit during charging, creating fire risk. Consumer Action: Stop charging battery and recycle at authorized drop-off depot. Recall Number: BATT-26-880

BURN HAZARD WARNING: CHILDREN SLEEPWEAR Product Name: CozyKids Fleece Pajama Sets Manufacturer: Global Apparel Solutions Notice Date: 2026-10-01 Hazard: Sleepwear fails to meet federal flammability standards. Remedy: Keep away from fire and return for full purchase price refund. Recall Number: CPSC-26-940

CRITICAL ALERT: RESIDENTIAL SMOKE DETECTOR Product Name: SafeGuard Dual-Sensor Smoke Alarm Manufacturer: SafeGuard Home Security Inc. Recall Date: 2026-10-05 Hazard: Battery contact corrosion may silence alarm during active smoke event. Action: Contact SafeGuard customer service for expedited sensor replacement. Model Number: SG-SMOKE-2026

MEDICAL EQUIPMENT SAFETY ALERT: INFUSION PUMP Product: MediFlow Automated Infusion Pump System Manufacturer: MediTech Health Systems Date: 2026-10-08 Hazard: Software defect causes inaccurate fluid delivery rates. Remedy: Hospital biomedical engineers must apply firmware patch v3.2. Recall Campaign: MED-26-707

खाद्य सुरक्षा एवं मानक प्राधिकरण जन सूचना उत्पाद: शुद्ध मसाला पावडर ५०० ग्राम निर्माता: भारत स्पाइस उद्योग प्राइवेट लिमिटेड दिनांक: 2026-05-15 खतरा: स्वास्थ्य के लिए हानिकारक मिलावट की पुष्टि। कार्रवाई: उपभोक्ता तुरंत उपयोग बंद करें और धनवापसी प्राप्त करें। रिकॉल क्रमांक: FSSAI-26-102

खिलौना सुरक्षा चेतावनी सूचना उत्पाद: बच्चों की इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कार टॉय ब्रांड: बाल आनंद टॉयज कॉर्पोरेशन दिनांक: 2026-06-20 खतरा: छोटे पुर्जों के टूटने से बच्चों के लिए दम घुटने का गंभीर जोखिम। सुझाव: बच्चों से खिलौना तुरंत दूर रखें और निकटतम केंद्र पर लौटाएं। सुरक्षा कोड: TOY-HI-26

अग्नि सुरक्षा रिकॉल बुलेटिन उत्पाद का नाम: घरेलू रूम हीटर 2000 वॉट निर्माता: सूर्य इलेक्ट्रिकल्स लिमिटेड सूचना दिनांक: 2026-07-11 खतरा: अत्यधिक गर्म होने पर आग लगने और जलने का खतरा। उपभोक्ता निर्देश: बिजली का प्लग निकालें और निशुल्क मरम्मत कराएं। रिकॉल पहचान: SURYA-26-09

वाहन सुरक्षा एवं गुणवत्ता चेतावनी वाहन मॉडल: गति ऑटो स्कूटर 125cc कंपनी: गति मोटर्स इंडिया लिमिटेड रिकॉल तिथि: 2026-08-04 खराबी: फ्रंट डिस्क ब्रेक के लॉक होने से दुर्घटना का अंदेशा। कदम: अधिकृत डीलर से संपर्क कर ब्रेक कैलीपर निःशुल्क बदलवाएं। अभियान संख्या: GATI-26-MOTO

OFFICIAL RECALL BULLETIN - PAGE 1 OF 3 UNITED STATES CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY COMMISSION General Notice for Portable Camping Stoves Summary: Joint voluntary recall of outdoor butane camping stoves. Issued: October 2026 Reference Document: CPSC-PDF-BULLETIN-2026

OFFICIAL RECALL BULLETIN - PAGE 2 OF 3 IDENTIFICATION AND HAZARD SPECIFICATIONS Product: CampPro Portable Butane Stove Model CP-2026 Hazard Description: Gas valve seal failure allows butane leakage causing flash fire. Units Affected: Approximately 38,000 units sold nationwide. Serial Number Range: CP26-0001 through CP26-3800

OFFICIAL RECALL BULLETIN - PAGE 3 OF 3 REMEDY AND CONSUMER CONTACT INFORMATION Remedy: Consumers should immediately cease using recalled stoves. Contact: CampPro Safety Hotline at 1-800-555-0199 Monday through Friday. Refund or replacement valve assembly provided free of charge. Bulletin Authorized by Office of Product Safety.
